title: Bitcoin falls below $60K, its lowest level since October 2024, amid a record streak of bitcoin ETF outflows following Strategy's bitcoin sale (CNBC)
summary: CNBC: Bitcoin falls below $60K, its lowest level since October 2024, amid a record streak of bitcoin ETF outflows following Strategy's bitcoin sale — Bitcoin extended its losses on Friday, dropping to October 2024 lows to cap an already bruising week for crypto investors.
